steps.note: Open the prebuilt live RFQ without recreating or changing its state.
Move to Vendor A's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ's pricing round from the vendor event list.
Verify the vendor sees the live RFQ title.
Verify the bid page shows the Terms & Conditions block.
Verify the quotation-template section is present.
Verify a Download control is shown with the quotation templates.
Verify the product sheet is rendered.
Verify the vendor sees the buyer's requested quantity.
Verify the vendor sees the item's unit.
Verify the product sheet includes the delivery-location field.
Verify the bid sheet includes the Price column.
Verify the vendor has the quote-submission control.
